caption: The drawing features a single yellow dress depicted in a vertical orientation, occupying the central area of the composition. The dress is long, reaching about ankle length, with thin shoulder straps and a slightly flared bottom hem. The bodice includes a gathered or ruched section under the bust, hinting at a loose fit and a flowing silhouette. The color of the dress is primarily yellow, rendered with various shades and highlights that suggest folds, seams, and dimensionality in the fabric. The background is an unadorned, off-white or light beige color, and there are no other objects or additional elements in the scene. The dress appears to be suspended or hanging, as no support structure is visible. The style of the drawing is naturalistic with careful attention to the nuances of light and shadow.
title: Dress
